supporting_pages.title: "Use vLLM on GKE to run inference with DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale \_|\_ AI Hypercomputer\
evidence_snippets: Create a Kubernetes secret to store your Hugging Face credentials To create a Kubernetes secret to store your Hugging Face credentials, do the following: Configure kubectl to communicate with your GKE cluster: gcloud container clusters get-credentials $CLUSTER NAME \ --location=$REGION Create a Kubernetes secret that contains the Hugging Face read access token that you created in an earlier step: kubectl create secret generic hf-secret \ --from-literal=hf token=${HUGGING FACE TOKEN} \ --dry-run=client -o yaml kubectl apply -f -
